description: Synthetic recall scenario; labels are test-only, never retrieval input. Dates are fixed, not relative to the test runner's clock.

fragments.title: What helped at the ferry desk
fragments.body: With the queue watching, nobody wanted to say they were lost. Giving each visitor a route card to mark in private worked better.

fragments.title: Volunteer orientation
fragments.body: Book the room and bring a spare projector for volunteer orientation.

fragments.title: Volunteer orientation
fragments.body: When we asked the room what was unclear, not one hand went up. Afterwards three people found me individually to ask where to go. Maybe try anonymous question slips?

cases.useful_inference: The private way to ask for help at the ferry desk may be worth trying at orientation.
cases.unsupported_inference: Anonymous slips have already worked at volunteer orientation.
